S_NO_UGC01281_DOMAIN_SAFE.rule: Exclude every UGC01281 radius, then require B(0.05)>0. Not activated.

rules.S_HARD2: Remove only radii with B<0 for every Upsilon in [0.05,1.5].
rules.S_DOMAIN13: Keep radii with B(0.05)>0. Stellar signed contribution is nonnegative, so B stays positive on [0.05,1.5].
rules.S_NO_UGC01281: Exclude the whole galaxy as an unactivated literature-sensitivity candidate.
rules.S_NO_UGC01281_DOMAIN_SAFE: Optional and unactivated: S_NO_UGC01281 intersect S_DOMAIN13.
